metadata.datasource:
Prepared for Negs from the manufacturer's datasheet: FUJIFILM Professional Film Data Guide (US), Ref. No. AF3-207U, (c) 2005 Fuji Photo Film Co., Ltd., PDF page 25 (spectral sensitivity, per-dye spectral density, characteristic curves; RMS granularity 8). PDF sha256 64c6455651b9f13f5cd190219e4928d1fdf13ecf33859c4691d830bced8d3d36. Data (c) FUJIFILM Corporation. The curves were read from the PDF's vector paths (tools/film_profiles/extract_pdf.py); the points and axis calibration are in data/profile-sources/fujifilm-reversal/fujifilm_velvia_100f/.
Method: spektrafilm's public-era profile creator by Andrea Volpato (commit b2c7fe6), its steps for positive films: D-min removed (base synthesised from the curves' D-min), log E zero where green is 0.735 over D-min, Fujifilm's own per-dye spectra scaled so equal amounts view as an 18.4 % neutral under the viewing illuminant, status-A unmixing, a 3 norm_cdfs curve fit, sensitivity balance, densitometer normalisation. Then Negs's steps: sensitivity scaled so an 18.4 % grey gives raw exposure 1 per channel under the reference illuminant, each channel aligned so log E 0 develops its metameric-neutral amount, and spektrafilm's slide grey-ramp refinement run on spektrafilm 28bf883 at data_trustability 1.0. hanatos2025 adaptation window [409.4, 25.8, 597.9, 47.8] fitted on the reflectance corpus (Otsu (https://github.com/enneract/otsu2018), Munsell (https://zenodo.org/records/3269912), human skin (https://www.nist.gov/programs-projects/reflectance-measurements-human-skin), forest colors (https://zenodo.org/records/3269920)) with a weak prior toward the median of spektrafilm's stored windows. Tools and procedure: tools/film_profiles, docs/adding-film-stocks.md D11.
Negs slide neutralisation (tools/film_profiles/neutralise_positive.py, a Negs step, not spektrafilm's): the red and blue curve models are moved so a grey card filmed at EV -3 to +2.5 and scanned stays neutral, while the status-A densities stay within about 0.10 D (or their deviation before the step, if larger; a soft limit) of the datasheet's characteristic curves, the curves change as little as possible and the DIR pre-correction does not fold; green is not touched. Weights tuned on Provia 100F and tested on Velvia 100, Ektachrome 100 and Kodachrome 64 (data/profile-sources/fujifilm-reversal/calibration/neutralisation_test.json). For this film: grey-ramp neutrality (EV -1 to +2) 0.0387 before, 0.0024 after; largest colour of the ramp C*ab 2.08 before, 1.28 after; largest curve change 0.058 D; worst status-A deviation from the datasheet 0.127 D (before 0.127 D).
Negs choices: reference illuminant D55 (daylight stock, exposed at 5400 K); viewing illuminant D50; no target print (a slide is viewed or scanned); log_sensitivity_density_over_min 1.0 as printed; spectra left empty (null) outside the published wavelength range; characteristic curves in log10 H as printed; use 'still' and antihalation 'strong' as the shipped spektrafilm Velvia 100 and Provia 100F; DIR couplers: its own table, the class default scaled uniformly so the DIR pre-correction does not fold (D8).
Recorded extraction exceptions: sensitivity x axis, gate 0.3 % of span: Hand-drafted chart (Professional Film Data Guide; plot about 95 x 85 pt, characteristic curves 140 x 113 pt) whose own gridlines are unevenly spaced by up to 1.6 pt, so no straight axis reproduces them within 0.2 %. Worst gridline 0.28 % of the span (0.95 nm); gate rounded up to the next 0.1 %. The error is bounded by the calibration against spektrafilm's own digitisations of Provia 100F and Velvia 100 and by the charts the guide repeats for other films (docs/adding-film-stocks.md D11). sensitivity y axis (relative): Sensitivity (log) labelled at 1.0 steps; only the two interior gridlines are drawn and the plot frame is not at its labels (2-3 % of a unit off), so the axis is fitted through the two gridlines, which fix the scale. The offset does not reach the profile: D5 rescales every channel. dye_density x axis, gate 0.4 % of span: Hand-drafted chart (Professional Film Data Guide; plot about 95 x 85 pt, characteristic curves 140 x 113 pt) whose own gridlines are unevenly spaced by up to 1.6 pt, so no straight axis reproduces them within 0.2 %. Worst gridline 0.31 % of the span (1.04 nm); gate rounded up to the next 0.1 %. The error is bounded by the calibration against spektrafilm's own digitisations of Provia 100F and Velvia 100 and by the charts the guide repeats for other films (docs/adding-film-stocks.md D11). characteristic y axis, gate 0.3 % of span: Hand-drafted chart (Professional Film Data Guide; plot about 95 x 85 pt, characteristic curves 140 x 113 pt) whose own gridlines are unevenly spaced by up to 1.6 pt, so no straight axis reproduces them within 0.2 %. Worst gridline 0.23 % of the span (0.00928 D); gate rounded up to the next 0.1 %. The error is bounded by the calibration against spektrafilm's own digitisations of Provia 100F and Velvia 100 and by the charts the guide repeats for other films (docs/adding-film-stocks.md D11).
